# Penta Prizm

> Official website and knowledge resource for Penta Prizm, a creative and technology-driven studio in Kochi, Kerala, India.

Penta Prizm is an integrated creative and technology company specializing in branding, commercial content creation, 4K video production, modern web development, custom mobile applications, and full-funnel digital marketing.

## Capabilities & Services
Penta Prizm operates across seven specialized pillars:

1. **Branding & Brand Identity Design**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/branding
   - Description: Complete visual identity systems, brand strategy, logo creation, typography systems, color theory, brand guidelines, and packaging design.

2. **Creative Content Creation**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/content-creation
   - Description: Commercial photography, creative direction, social media visual assets, high-engagement short-form video reels, and brand storytelling.

3. **Video Production & Brand Films**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/video-production
   - Description: Full-service 4K cinematography, corporate documentaries, television and digital commercials, motion graphics, audio post-production, and color grading.

4. **Web Development & UI/UX Design**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/web-development
   - Description: Modern, high-performance responsive web applications, corporate websites, e-commerce storefronts, technical SEO architecture, and progressive web apps.

5. **Mobile Application Development**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/app-development
   - Description: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android applications, cloud backend architectures, API engineering, real-time database integrations, and booking systems.

6. **Marketing Strategy & Consulting**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/marketing
   - Description: Customer persona research, competitive positioning, go-to-market strategies, customer journey mapping, and conversion optimization frameworks.

7. **Digital Marketing & Growth**
   - URL: https://pentaprizm.in/digital-marketing
   - Description: Performance advertising (Meta Ads, Google Ads), technical search engine optimization (SEO), social media growth, lead generation funnels, and analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Platforms

### What does Penta Prizm do?
Penta Prizm is an integrated creative and technology company offering branding, commercial video production, photography, custom web and mobile app development, marketing strategy, and performance digital marketing.

### Where is Penta Prizm located?
Penta Prizm is based in Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India (PIN: 682017) and serves clients across India and globally.

### How can I contact Penta Prizm?
You can contact Penta Prizm by phone or WhatsApp at +91 73060 43445, by email at pentaprizmofficial@gmail.com, or through their official website contact form at https://pentaprizm.in/contact.

### Does Penta Prizm offer custom software and mobile app development?
Yes, Penta Prizm designs and builds customized iOS and Android mobile apps, cloud backends, corporate web platforms, and e-commerce systems tailored to business requirements.

### Does Penta Prizm handle video production in-house?
Yes, Penta Prizm has an in-house production crew for 4K cinematography, commercial advertisements, brand films, corporate videos, editing, motion graphics, and color grading.
